steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Commissioner, we have people watching all paths in and out of the slums, as you ordered.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Good. Keep watch in shifts around the clock. Not a single musbeast gets in or get out today.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you sure a massive operation like this is a good idea? It might do the exact opposite of what you want.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's been two weeks since the Rat King stepped aside and put Miss Lin in charge. The slums have been pretty quiet in the meanwhile.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But then again, it's been two weeks since we saw anything of the stinking rat.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Do you think it's possible for leadership of the slums to change hands without so much as a peep?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Skinny Cheung, Savant Lee, Ghost Eye... do you think the kingpins would just sit on their hands after the Rat King kept them in check for so many years?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Skinny Cheung abducted one of the stinking rat's people today. She's bound to make a move.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I bet Miss Lin can handle it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I don't need her to handle it. The slums are part of Lungmen.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's true. I'm with you on that.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Keep your eyes open for the people on your end. There's bound to be movement there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You just wait, you stupid rat.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Most people go to the bar to drink and dance. I go to the bar to have hotpot, uncultured man that I am.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Mr. Lin, the Dai Lo, used to frequent this place, eating and drinking with our gang.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Too bad it's getting demolished next week. I wanted to have one last dinner here, my way of saying goodbye.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Come, eat up!

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Come now, Wong, why are your chopsticks so still?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You had the guts to build a hospital on my turf, but not to have hotpot with me?

steps.name: Frightened Merchant
steps.text: Building the hospital was Miss Lin's idea.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You see? People these days just don't know how things are done.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Miss Lin is the Rat King's heir, she's got her hands full every single day! A legend like her is bound to forget a thing or two.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Underlings like us, our job is to make our boss's job easier, isn't it?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Am I right, Wong? Now tell me again: was it my dear Yühsia who forgot, or was it you who forgot?

steps.name: Frightened Merchant
steps.text: I-It was me who forgot.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: That's more like it. Even your Miss Lin has to call me uncle when she sees me. She would never do such a thing without running it by me first, would she?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: It's all a misunderstanding.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You're shivering, Wong. Are you cold? Seems like your memory isn't so good either.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You should have some soup from the pot. Eat it while it's hot. It'll do you some good. And then you can deliver my message to dear Yühsia.

steps.name: Frightened Merchant
steps.text: I... I... please, Mr. Cheung... have mercy...
The merchant tries to get out of his chair to kowtow, but a hand presses on his shoulder.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Well, well. Look who it is. If it isn't my dear Yühsia.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: A little advice from your Uncle Cheung, kiddo. You won't achieve anything with such wimpy underlings.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Back in my day, I had to bite a plate to pieces and swallow it in front of a bunch of dai los, just so your dad wouldn't lose face.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Times have changed, Uncle Cheung. Business these days is about win-win.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Wong's wife is in labor. Let him go.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's me you're looking for. I'll have some hotpot with you.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Perfect.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You can go, Wong.

steps.name: Frightened Merchant
steps.text: Sorry, Miss Lin.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's not your fault.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Come, Yühsia, let's eat. Chop chop!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're my elder, Uncle Cheung. If you had something to say to me, you could have told me directly. There's no need for this.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: We've seen what you're capable of these past few years. I supported your dad passing his mantle to you.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Rules are everything in the underworld. Now that you're the one calling the shots, I can't very well treat you like a kid.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: If I may say so, you seem to be treating me like an enemy, rather than like a leader.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You're exaggerating. Without rules, there is only chaos, but we must treat others with courtesy to find our own place.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You're building on my turf without a single word. You clearly want to undermine me.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I just had to remind you to not push things too far, lest someone be forced to push back.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What if I told you I didn't tell you on purpose?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: And they say Yühsia has no sense of humor!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm not joking, Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Do you think you can do anything you want, now that you're a leader?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I became the leader to stop certain people from doing anything they want.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Does your dad know about this?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: As you said, Uncle Cheung, I'm the one calling the shots now.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Looks like I have to help Old Lin teach his daughter a lesson, on his behalf.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Come on, Fat Kwan. We'll have hotpot with my dear Yühsia here.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: Grab the guys. Tell them to grab their weapons.

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: Are we really gonna do this? I thought Miss Lin was the new boss.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: A boss is only a boss with the support of the underlings.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: She's barely been on the job a few days, and she's already going over Cheung's head. Does she think the slums belong to the Lins?

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: B-But she's the Rat King's daughter. What if the Rat King is backing this...?

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: You think the Rat King would've needed to go through his daughter if he wanted to do something to Cheung?

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: So... is the Rat King just letting his daughter run amok?

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: We all know Miss Lin does things differently from the Rat King.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: And we all know about her dealings with certain people out in the mainstream.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: But no one imagined she would go so far as to flout the rules of the slums, the way we've been living for decades.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: I doubt even the Rat King could have predicted that his daughter would forget where she came from like this.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: All we're doing is helping the Rat King teach his daughter a lesson. Understand?

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: Got it! I'll get the boys together.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Looks like you came prepared.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Just sharing the hotpot with the boys. Sharing is caring, as they say.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: It won't be so bad, I promise. I've still gotta answer to your dad, after all.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You still don't understand, do you, Uncle Cheung? My father isn't involved anymore. How do you expect to answer to him?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You really think he's uninvolved? Just because he says so? How many slum dwellers only listen to him?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Did you really think you could be the boss without their support?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I have my own connections, my own businesses. None of these have anything to do with my father.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Now, now, young lady, a word of advice from your Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Young people like you think the old folks like me are behind the times. You want to leave us in the dust. I get it.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Just because you want to leave certain things behind, though, doesn't mean you can.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: If your dad wants to get together for lunch tomorrow, how are we supposed to do that when you step on my toes like this? If Auntie Wong wants to go shopping with your mom, do they have to call it off?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You're usually so thoughtful and careful. What's got into you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You put too much stock in favors and relationships, that's all, Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You brat...

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I didn't want to go so far, Yühsia, but it looks like this is going to hurt.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Hey, Lee, it's me.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Make sure about the hospital.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: Commissioner Wong? It's me, Lee Man-Heng from Excelsior Construction.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Of course I remember. I wouldn't have known something so delicious existed on Terra, if not for you.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: I had heard that you were something of a gourmet. Glad to hear it was worth the effort getting those delicacies imported all the way from Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Well, I'm glad to have a friend like you. Anything you need help with, just let me know.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: Well, then, if you wouldn't mind... you know about the new hospital in the slums, don't you?

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Of course. The whole city has eyes on it.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: But the bidding is already over, right? A company from the slums won the project, if I recall correctly.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: You understand how tough things are for small businesses like us.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: We had our eyes on this project, but we got cut off by the slum folk.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: I sympathize, Mr. Lee, but I understand the bidding was won legitimately.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: I know, but perhaps you overlooked a few errors in the documents they submitted.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Are you sure about this? A couple of minor problems won't change the outcome.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: But there's a possibility that it may affect the outcome, isn't there?

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: I just wanted to give you a heads-up. All you need to do is nod when we submit our complaint.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: We won't bother you at all with the other stuff.

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: I got some more goodies in from Bolívar. They'll arrive next month. I hope you can join me in the tasting.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: ...Hah. Sure. No problem.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Now, my dear Yühsia, we can enjoy our hotpot.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There's no rush.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I have something I wanted to ask, Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Sure. I'm happy to answer, as long as it's something I know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Lungmen takes in vagrants from the barrenlands from time to time. Most of the time, they end up in the slums.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: To prevent their numbers from growing out of control, Chief Wei has signed aid agreements with other countries, in order to allow people to return to their homes.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But some of them always go missing. Sometimes, they go missing after reaching their destination. Sometimes, the person's not on the list, but they go missing from the slums.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I thought it was a coincidence at first, but as the investigation continued, I realized that someone was engaging in human trafficking, under the guise of aid.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You were nothing if not careful, Uncle Cheung. You find a different buyer each time, and you always sell the people to a number of different places.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It took me years to finally identify a lead.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you recognize the people in these photos, Uncle Cheung?
Lin Yühsia takes out a few photos from her pouch. The people in the photos are thin and emaciated.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's what I thought.

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: Ready?

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: Yeah, the boys are here!

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Fat Kwan's Lackey
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: This is Cheung's turf! Who the hell are you?!

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Fat Kwan
steps.text: Wh-Who are you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Come out.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Is it him?

steps.name: Angry Man
steps.text: Yes, that's the one. I'll never forget his voice... he was the one who killed my dad!

steps.name: Frightened Woman
steps.text: I remember him too! I spent a dozen years in the Ursine mines because of him!

steps.name: Nervous Old Man
steps.text: Yes... yes... I'll remember his tattoo even if he were burned to ashes... he was the one who sold me to Rim Billiton!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: He can't move. Miss Lin says you can do anything you want to him.
There is a mixture of surprise and anger on the faces of these people when they see Fat Kwan. At the words of Lin Yühsia's lieutenant, a few of them muster the courage to kick Fat Kwan a few times.
Most of them, however, cower behind.
On their faces is the fear that has followed them through all their years abroad.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, on behalf of Miss Lin, I promise you that your nightmares have come to an end.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: That's because—

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Everybody, freeze!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I hear fighting. What's going on?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Because the L.G.D. is here to help you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're the stinking rat's lackey?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Commissioner Swire, I hereby report on behalf of Miss Lin the crimes of human trafficking that Cheung Man-Ho, Fat Kwan, and those associated with them have engaged in over the years.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: We have the witnesses here. As for the evidence...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: We have that here too.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: We have faith that you will deliver justice for these people.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ding nei goh fai, the stupid rat had it all planned out, didn't she?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia's Subordinate
steps.text: Miss Lin simply—

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: That's enough. Take Fat Kwan's gang into custody, and bring the witnesses into protection.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're not going anywhere either, stinking rat gang. You're gonna need to come to the station and make a statement.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Where are you going, commissioner?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: ...I'm in the mood for some hot pot.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You see, Yühsia, there were multiple foreign syndicates trying to take root in the slums.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Your dad is strong, but not invincible. It was no sure bet that he could have established himself here, if I wasn't there to take some of the pressure off him.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I don't blame you for not understanding the complexities, Yühsia. You weren't born at the time, after all.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad said a lot of blood would have been shed in the slums, if you didn't stand up and step forward.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Little did he know that the one appreciated so much was dealing with those foreign syndicates, helping them with their human trafficking business.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I had no choice!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There is always a way, if not at the time, then certainly afterward.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How many of those deeds were done because you had no choice, how many were just you deceiving yourself, and how many were just because you couldn't bring yourself to stop?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You weren't there, Yühsia. Don't talk like you know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: True, I wasn't there.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And I prefer it that way.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Did you ever go looking for them, Uncle Cheung? Did you try to help them? Do anything for them?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Have you ever seen them standing despondent before their unrecognizable old homes? Have you ever seen them crying before the graves of their loved ones?

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Spare me, Yühsia.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: You think that kind of talk will rattle me?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Of course not. I'm not that naive.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I just wanted to remind you, in case you forgot.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But I'm sure you remember the people in this photo.
Lin Yühsia takes out another photo from her pouch.
It is one of Skinny Cheung, President Lee, and Commissioner Wong laughing and drinking together.
A shadow comes over Skinny Cheung's expression.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Lee has left Commissioner Wong's office, sir. What do we do?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Keep an eye on him. I'll go have a chat with Commissioner Wong.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: ...Come in.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Commissioner Wong, I am Inspector Hoshiguma, L.G.D. I would like to talk to you.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Good timing, Inspector. I have a report to make...

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: Correction. I'm surrendering myself.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: I am confessing that I covered up the illegal bidding activities of certain corporations.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: I am also reporting that Lee Man-Heng of Excelsior Construction is attempting to illegally influence the bidding result of the new hospital project in the slums.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: He was just here. I recorded our conversation.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: The one behind him is Cheung Man-Ho of the slums, who has repeatedly influenced project bidding over the years with a mixture of bribery and violence.

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: I have the evidence.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Who put you up to this?

steps.name: Commissioner Wong
steps.text: No one, Inspector. I'm doing it of my own accord.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Miss Lin.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Lee Man-Heng... a familiar name to many inhabitants of the slums.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: His company was responsible for much of the slums' infrastructure. One could even call him the great benefactor of the slums.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: When I was little, Dad told me how Uncle Cheung's friend, Mr. Lee, built all these buildings in the slums. I was very grateful to him.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's no exaggeration to say that he was the one who inspired me to build the slums' first public hospital.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But as I began to study these things and embarked on this path, I started to learn how much investment and aid he embezzled with those government officials whom he was in league with.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Those buildings that I admired so much were built using cheap, inferior materials, allowing him to embezzle millions of dollars through his construction projects.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The one who cajoled him into taking this path...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Was you, Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: He was the one who approached me first. He said there was immense potential here.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Does it matter who was first?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Together, the two of you stole from the many thousands of families who live in the slums, in order to fund your comforts and excesses.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: It's true there are certain things I've kept hidden from your dad over the years.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Some of them I had no choice. The others, though, I must admit I had a choice.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I do feel guilty towards your dad for those.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: And it makes me feel better now that you've pointed them out, and I can finally admit them to myself.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: But that's all the more reason why I can't let you leave.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I'm sorry, Yühsia, but you're going to have to come with me.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Once I'm safe—

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Lee? What is it?

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: Help me, Cheung!

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: The L.G.D. just arrested me!

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: President Lee
steps.text: Cheung? Cheung! Don't hang—

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: ...Ugh.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Fat Kwan's at the station too. You can go see both of them together.
The communicator has hardly beeped twice before Swire walks in, throwing Fat Kwan's communicator in front of Skinny Cheung.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Is there another call you would like to make, Uncle Cheung?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I can do it for you. Savant Lee, Ghost Eye, Mr. Wong, Mr. Chan...
Lin Yühsia takes out a communicator from her pouch, keeping her eye firmly on Skinny Cheung.
Skinny Cheung does not answer. He leans back in his chair, his hand clutching the communicator tightly. A thousand expressions flash across his face.
It is over.
Finally, he closes his eyes and exhales deeply.
It is as though he has aged ten years.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We all reap what we sow, Uncle Cheung.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: What about your Auntie Wong?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'll tell her personally.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Your son's schooling will not be affected.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: I used to think I could stick to my principles, just like you.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: But take one step down the wrong path, and you go astray forever.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Tell your dad... Cheung Man-Ho is sorry.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Skinny Cheung
steps.text: Take me to Fat Kwan and Lee, Commissioner Swire.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The police car's outside. You need an escort?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Uncle Cheung was good to me when I was little.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: When I was eight, he threw his new, expensive watch into a well, just so I would smile.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You sure were one mean, stupid rat.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I still am.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't you dare think you did me a favor. The L.G.D. was already on Skinny Cheung's tail.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Just cleaning house.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Well, well. Look at you, Lin the heroine, eliminating a thorn in the L.G.D.'s side so soon after coming back from Yumen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You could bring people into the slums without anybody noticing, and even influence the government's treasury department.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How about I tell Chief Wei to name you the next Commissioner?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Right now, there are certain things that have to be dealt with this way.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The walls between the slums and Lungmen must be taken down slowly, piece by piece.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You think we'd be standing here talking if I didn't?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What do you think I surrounded the slums for? Was it to catch you, or to protect you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You're not dumb enough to think that you have to catch me today. And you're not so nice that you would let me leave if I slipped up.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Good. Don't you forget it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Lungmen needed the slums in your father's time. That doesn't mean Lungmen always will.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't tell me you forgot what we said when we were in school.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: 'Nobody is born to spend their life in the slums. The day will come when those in the slums will see the sun.'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've never forgotten. I wonder if a certain someone has, though. She couldn't even keep a promise, after all.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You're one petty woman.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How long do you intend to keep nagging me about that?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm a mean, stupid rat, after all. Why wouldn't I make the most of this one weakness of yours?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Talking to you raises my blood pressure to dangerous levels. I should ask Hoshiguma to get me some medicine.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Anyway, as long as you remember what we said and never forget whom you're fighting for...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The L.G.D. won't stop you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Is the Commissioner of the L.G.D. offering immunity to this humble citizen?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Think of it as the Commissioner of the L.G.D. putting restraints on this humble citizen.
Swire takes out a pair of handcuffs.
She puts one cuff around Lin Yühsia's wrist, and the other around her own.
Lin Yühsia does not resist.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Anyway, you've got to come to the station to make a statement.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Pick up your own mess.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm hungry after running around the slums all day.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let's have some hotpot!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Put the vegetables in, you stinking rat.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why me?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I put the handcuffs on my dominant hand.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You're old and you're injured. You shouldn't be climbing high places like this.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: Wanted to say goodbye to an old friend. My leg's bad, but the least I could do is pour out some liquor for him.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is it your leg that failed you, or your shame?

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: Do you remember that headstrong kid who said he wouldn't let anyone touch a single hair on your head or mine, so long as he still breathed?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: He worked under me for thirty years. I gave him a good life for thirty years.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: I could never imagine he was keeping so much hidden from me.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: I owe him nothing.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But you couldn't bring yourself to do it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And you didn't expect your daughter to be so decisive.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The Rat King of the slums, hiding because he's afraid to see his own daughter. What will people think?

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: I must object.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: I'm not the Rat King anymore, just an old man with too much time on his hands.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: I'm happier than anyone else that my daughter is growing up faster than I ever expected.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You've let it go.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: Of course I have. Even if I didn't want to see her now, we still have to eat at the same table later.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: That niece of yours, though? You couldn't see her, even if you wanted.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You had to bring it up, didn't you?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Nothing has changed. If she decides to come back, Lungmen will be the best backing she could possibly have.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: We've all grown old, old friend.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: But I'm not too worried about the young ones we've entrusted Lungmen's future to.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You'll grow old even quicker if you say things like that.

steps.name: Lin Kojui
steps.text: Hah hah hah.
